title: The worst chart for bitcoin bulls right now
summary: For 14 years, one ratio only moved in bitcoin's favor. Now it has decisively turned the other way and bulls may not like what it means.

title: New Ethereum proposal would cut issuance to zero if staked ETH reaches $112 billion
summary: The EIP-8361 draft proposal calls for burning a rising share of validator rewards as the staking ratio climbs.

title: "You stole, please return some." Coldcard hacker's wallet becomes a graffiti wall of pleas and hustles
summary: A wallet holding $36 million in stolen bitcoin has become an unlikely public message board, as hack victims and opportunists pay to leave permanent notes for the thief.

title: Bitcoin flat at $64,000 as stocks print records and Hormuz deal nears
summary: BTC held near $64,000 as MSCI's world index set another peak and Brent fell toward a Hormuz deal. Ether is the only major down on the week.

title: SpaceX tops Wall Street revenue forecast, posts $540 million loss on bitcoin holdings
